<List<Document> get() {
    System.out.println("Start processing paragraphs from PDF");
    
    List<Document> documents = new ArrayList<>();
    
    if (paragraphs == null || paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
        System.out.println("End processing paragraphs from PDF");
        return documents;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < paragraphs.size(); i++) {
        String currentParagraph = paragraphs.get(i);
        String nextParagraph = (i < paragraphs.size() - 1) ? paragraphs.get(i + 1) : paragraphs.get(i);
        
        Document doc = new Document(currentParagraph, nextParagraph);
        
        if (doc != null && doc.getText() != null && !doc.getText().isEmpty()) {
            documents.add(doc);
        }
    }
    
    System.out.println("End processing paragraphs from PDF");
    return documents;
}

    private String nextText;
    
    public Document(String text, String nextText) {
        this.text = text;
        this.nextText = nextText;
    }
    
    public String getText() {
        return text;
    }
    
    public String getNextText() {
        return nextText;
    }
